answer: The record only grows, and a mask that appears twice is caught by its own echo. I trust a proof that lives outside the applicant's hands, and Dome-gilder gold leaf sheet mark burnished into the gilt chapel is that proof: each gold leaf sheet is a season of logged gold-leaf beatings plus a signed gilder. Trust is sold per proof at 154 POA, and the farm's 146 proofs lock up 22484 POA it never sees again if it cheats. One karst is a pass, one tide is a fare, one ferrous is the stamp on the pass, and the stamp cannot be bought at any price.
